infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loc8 uses your location to show your crew where you are, including during authorised offline sessions.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Loc8 keeps location updates active in the background during an active session so nearby crew devices can receive them.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Loc8 uses the compass to point the arrow toward your friends.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Loc8 uses Bluetooth to find your crew directly, phone-to-phone, when there's no internet.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Loc8 scans a crew QR code to join your crew.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Loc8 uses your photos to set your profile picture.
